gap1_threat_aggro.key_finding: Threat is a client-side display list. No accrual/decay formulas in binary. Server sends ordered entity ID array via onThreatenedMobsUpdate. Two distinct threat sets on GamePlayer: primary at +0x16c (bulk update), secondary at +0x178 (per-entity delta).
open_questions: Purpose distinction between two threat sets (+0x16c vs +0x178)
Max-target cap: controlled server-side by truncating array length

gap2_effect_stacking_dr.key_finding: All DR/immunity logic is server-side. Client tracks active effects via EffectSet with no stack cap. Same SecondaryId = refresh; different SecondaryId = new stack. CC immunity and DR result communicated via StatResultCode byte in ClientEffectResult (0=None, 1=Immune, 2=Absorb, 3=Mortal). BSF_Holster (bit 8) NOT processed by onStateFieldUpdate handler — separate mechanism.

CategoryId=9 in removal emit — unclear if same namespace as result codes

gap3_damage_pipeline.key_finding: Damage pipeline fully client-side confirmed as pass-through. Server sends pre-computed Delta (float). CombatQueue extracts fields, filters by local player/target visibility, builds 0x14-byte per-entry structs, drains via ring buffer. QR result code table is 20 entries (not 5 as previously documented). Kismet event IDs extended: cast lifecycle at 1000-1003, entity lifecycle at 5000-5004. Codes 0-1 (ABILITY_INTERRUPT/FAILED) carry no stat deltas.
